The '''Thikkiiana computer fabrication facility''' was located at the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] city of [[Thikkiiana City/Legends|Thikkiiana City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] era. It was assaulted by the breakaway [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] faction known as the [[Second Imperium]] during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Imperium Crisis)|raid]] on Thikkiiana City as part of an attempt to steal computers for their fleet. The facility suffered extensive damage during the attack.

[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] used the finest components from the Thikkiiana facility to construct [[M-TD]], a [[Translator droid/Legends|translator droid]] used by his nephew, [[Lowbacca]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
